label: Open-crown orchard row
description: Three low forked fruit trees with overlapping asymmetric crown lobes and lateral branches; decorative row only.

label: Wire-trained orchard row
description: Narrow pruned crowns, individual stakes, end posts and two training wires; posts meet the local ground datum.

label: Mixed shrub hedge
description: Seven interlocking irregular shrub masses on visible rooted stems, with a low broken silhouette.

label: Laid hedge on low bank
description: Raised bounded earth bank, angled woody stems, stakes and low regrowth; a static rural boundary assembly.

label: Raised-bank irrigation channel
description: Two bounded trapezoidal earth banks with sloped faces and narrow grass-tufted crests around a darker damp-colored bed. Flat gallery datum at y=0; no terrain excavation or simulated water.

label: Lined channel with sluice
description: Light concrete sloped channel lining with transverse joints across bed and banks, and grounded steel gate posts carrying a screw-operated sluice. Bounded raised assembly on a flat y=0 datum; no terrain excavation or water flow.

label: Open-seat utility tractor
description: Static tractor facing -Z with large rear tires, small steering tires, engine grille, exhaust, fenders, seat, steps, hitch and roll bar.

label: Enclosed-cab utility tractor
description: Utility tractor with a framed opaque-glazed cab and overhanging roof, engine, exhaust and agricultural tread. Static prop, no driving or wheel animation.

label: Single-axle farm flatbed
description: Open timber deck with end racks, exposed underframe, one axle and triangular drawbar resting on a grounded parking jack; faces -Z.

label: Tandem-axle grain tipper
description: Empty open-top tall steel grain body, external ribs, tandem axles and stowed ram on a parked drawbar chassis. Body is not animated.

label: Short field grass patch
description: Fifteen low rooted tufts of opaque bent tapered blades; sparse decorative ground growth without a rectangular base plate.

label: Dry tussock scatter
description: Nine taller separated muted straw-green tussocks with splayed blades and gaps; distinct from the low dense sward.

label: Flowering rush bed
description: Eighteen varied-height rooted stems, bent basal leaves and branching pale seed panicles. Place on a supporting bank, not floating over water.

label: Cattail reed bed
description: Slender rooted stems and basal leaves crowned by dark cylindrical seed heads. Decorative vegetation; no water or cover behavior.

label: Snapped standing snag
description: Root buttresses, tapering standing trunk, two broken branch stubs and uneven exposed heartwood splinters.

label: Stump and fallen bough
description: Rooted low stump beside a grounded tapered fallen trunk, raised snapped twigs and visible cut heartwood; no spherical foliage.
